subject: gse/sgp-correlations
body: Same-game leg correlations ESTIMATED from data. The SGP copula runner had a hand-set correlation matrix; it now reads a measured one. intelligence/props/sgp_correlation_estimator.py over nflverse play-by-play (CC-BY), 1088 team-games, seasons 2024-2025: qb_pass_yards~wr_rec_yards 0.6995 (guess was 0.65), qb_pass_tds~wr_anytime_td 0.4927, wr_rec_yards~wr_anytime_td 0.3251 (guess was 0.52 -- overstated by 60%). Matrix is PSD, min eigenvalue 0.2605. 4-leg alpha moves +343.07% -> +293.87% with measured dependence; the independence error still dominates any single-leg edge. 54/54 pytest pass. Raw pbp not committed (scoped gitignore); the derived matrix is.
